name: French Polynesia

flag.description: Three horizontal bands of red, white and red, the white band twice as tall, with a central disc showing a Polynesian outrigger canoe in front of a golden sun, above blue and white waves.
flag.symbolism: Red-white-red goes back to the flags of the old Kingdom of Tahiti; the canoe carries five figures for the five archipelagos, sailing between the sun and the ocean.

hook: French Polynesia is Lebanon's red-white-red layout, but instead of a green cedar the white band holds a canoe sailing in front of a golden sun.
trivia: The five figures in the canoe stand for the Society, Tuamotu, Gambier, Marquesas and Austral archipelagos.
Its 118 islands and atolls are scattered across an area of ocean about the size of Western Europe.
